```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
LIFE HUD – Möbii³us Unified Service
Tamagotchi Life Coach + Conditional RMS Bio-Audio Gate
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import BaseModel
import asyncio
import numpy as np
import time
import json
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
from collections import deque
import sqlite3
import os
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger("life_hud")

# ============================================================
# CONDITIONAL RMS MODULE
# ============================================================

class ConditionalRMS:
    """Gated RMS with Caputo fractional smoothing."""
    
    def __init__(self, window_size: int = 128, alpha: float = 0.6, trigger_threshold: float = 0.743):
        self.window = deque(maxlen=window_size)
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.trigger_threshold = trigger_threshold
        self.last_rms = 0.0
        self.caputo_memory = deque(maxlen=10)
        self.trigger_active = False
        
    def update(self, sample: float, state: Dict[str, float]) -> tuple:
        """Return (raw_rms, trigger_active, smoothed_rms)."""
        self.window.append(sample)
        
        # Check trigger condition
        hrv_coherence = state.get('hrv_coherence', 1.0)
        self.trigger_active = hrv_coherence < self.trigger_threshold
        
        if self.trigger_active and len(self.window) > 1:
            raw_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(self.window)))
            # Apply Caputo smoothing
            if len(self.caputo_memory) > 0:
                smoothed = (1 - self.alpha) * raw_rms + self.alpha * self.caputo_memory[-1]
            else:
                smoothed = raw_rms
            self.caputo_memory.append(smoothed)
            self.last_rms = smoothed
            return raw_rms, True, smoothed
        
        return 0.0, False, self.last_rms
    
    def get_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "trigger_active": self.trigger_active,
            "last_rms": self.last_rms,
            "threshold": self.trigger_threshold,
            "alpha": self.alpha
        }

# ============================================================
# TAMAGOTCHI ENGINE
# ============================================================

class TamagotchiEngine:
    """Life Coach Tamagotchi – soul metrics & evolution."""
    
    STAGES = [
        {"name": "Egg", "health_min": 0, "health_max": 19, "emoji": "🥚", "unlocks": "Basic reminders"},
        {"name": "Sprout", "health_min": 20, "health_max": 39, "emoji": "🌱", "unlocks": "Goal templates, daily quote"},
        {"name": "Seeker", "health_min": 40, "health_max": 69, "emoji": "🌿", "unlocks": "Voice journaling, weekly review"},
        {"name": "Sage", "health_min": 70, "health_max": 100, "emoji": "🕯️", "unlocks": "Wisdom archive, peer mentoring"}
    ]
    
    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "tamagotchi.db"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._init_db()
        self._load_state()
        
    def _init_db(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_state (
                key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                value REAL,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        """)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_history (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                event_type TEXT,
                metric TEXT,
                delta REAL,
                new_value REAL,
                timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                coherence REAL
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        
    def _load_state(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        cur = conn.execute("SELECT key, value FROM tamagotchi_state")
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        
        defaults = {
            "intent": 50.0,
            "action": 50.0,
            "reflection": 50.0,
            "kindness": 50.0,
            "health": 50.0,
            "stage_idx": 0,
            "total_cred": 0,
            "streak": 0,
            "last_checkin": None,
            "last_action": None,
            "last_journal": None,
            "last_forgive": None,
            "dormant_days": 0
        }
        
        self.state = defaults.copy()
        for key, value in rows:
            self.state[key] = value
            
    def _save_state(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        for key, value in self.state.items():
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tamagotchi_state (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (key, value)
            )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        
    def _log_event(self, event_type: str, metric: str, delta: float, coherence: float = 0.85):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO tamagotchi_history (event_type, metric, delta, new_value, coherence) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (event_type, metric, delta, self.state[metric], coherence)
        )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        
    def _recalculate_health(self):
        metrics = [self.state.get(m, 50) for m in ["intent", "action", "reflection", "kindness"]]
        self.state["health"] = sum(metrics) / len(metrics)
        
    def _update_stage(self):
        health = self.state["health"]
        for idx, stage in enumerate(self.STAGES):
            if stage["health_min"] <= health <= stage["health_max"]:
                self.state["stage_idx"] = idx
                break
                
    @property
    def stage(self) -> Dict:
        return self.STAGES[self.state["stage_idx"]]
    
    @property
    def health(self) -> float:
        return self.state["health"]
        
    def update_intent(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 10.0
        self.state["intent"] = min(100, self.state["intent"] + delta)
        self.state["last_checkin"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["streak"] = min(100, self.state.get("streak", 0) + 1)
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("checkin", "intent", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta
        
    def update_action(self, description: str, duration_minutes: int = 5) -> float:
        delta = 15.0
        self.state["action"] = min(100, self.state["action"] + delta)
        self.state["last_action"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 1
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("action", "action", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta
        
    def update_reflection(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 12.0
        self.state["reflection"] = min(100, self.state["reflection"] + delta)
        self.state["last_journal"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 2
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("journal", "reflection", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta
        
    def update_kindness(self) -> float:
        delta = 20.0
        self.state["kindness"] = min(100, self.state["kindness"] + delta)
        self.state["last_forgive"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        # Reset decay for today
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("forgive", "kindness", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta
        
    def apply_daily_decay(self):
        """Apply decay for missed daily actions."""
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        
        # Intent decay: -10 per missed day
        if self.state["last_checkin"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_checkin"])
            days_missed = (now - last).days
            if days_missed > 0:
                decay = min(10 * days_missed, 50)
                self.state["intent"] = max(0, self.state["intent"] - decay)
                
        # Action decay: -5 per missed day
        if self.state["last_action"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_action"])
            days_missed = (now - last).days
            if days_missed > 0:
                decay = min(5 * days_missed, 25)
                self.state["action"] = max(0, self.state["action"] - decay)
                
        # Reflection decay: -3 per missed day
        if self.state["last_journal"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_journal"])
            days_missed = (now - last).days
            if days_missed > 0:
                decay = min(3 * days_missed, 15)
                self.state["reflection"] = max(0, self.state["reflection"] - decay)
                
        # Kindness decay: -2 per day without forgiveness
        if self.state["last_forgive"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_forgive"])
            days_missed = (now - last).days
            if days_missed > 0:
                decay = min(2 * days_missed, 10)
                self.state["kindness"] = max(0, self.state["kindness"] - decay)
                
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._save_state()
        
    def get_full_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "intent": round(self.state["intent"], 1),
            "action": round(self.state["action"], 1),
            "reflection": round(self.state["reflection"], 1),
            "kindness": round(self.state["kindness"], 1),
            "health": round(self.state["health"], 1),
            "stage": self.stage["name"],
            "emoji": self.stage["emoji"],
            "stage_idx": self.state["stage_idx"],
            "total_cred": self.state.get("total_cred", 0),
            "streak": self.state.get("streak", 0),
            "unlocks": self.stage["unlocks"],
            "last_checkin": self.state.get("last_checkin"),
            "last_action": self.state.get("last_action"),
            "last_journal": self.state.get("last_journal"),
            "last_forgive": self.state.get("last_forgive"),
            "dormant_days": self.state.get("dormant_days", 0)
        }
        
    def get_history(self, limit: int = 50) -> List[Dict]:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        cur = conn.execute(
            "SELECT event_type, metric, delta, new_value, timestamp, coherence FROM tamagotchi_history ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
            (limit,)
        )
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return [
            {
                "event_type": r[0],
                "metric": r[1],
                "delta": r[2],
                "new_value": r[3],
                "timestamp": r[4],
                "coherence": r[5]
            }
            for r in rows
        ]

# HRV simulator (replace with real BLE sensor)
class HRVSimulator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.coherence = 0.85
        self.stress_timer = 0
        
    async def stream(self):
        while True:
            # Simulate occasional stress events
            self.stress_timer += 1
            if self.stress_timer > 30 and np.random.random() < 0.1:
                self.coherence = 0.6 + np.random.random() * 0.1  # stressed
                self.stress_timer = 0
            else:
                drift = np.random.normal(0, 0.01)
                self.coherence = np.clip(self.coherence + drift, 0.5, 0.95)
            yield self.coherence
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)  # 2 Hz sample rate

    return {"status": "ok", "health": tamagotchi.health}

# ============================================================
# WEBSOCKET: LIVE CONDITIONAL RMS STREAM
# ============================================================

@app.websocket("/ws/life-hud")
async def websocket_life_hud(websocket: WebSocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    active_connections.append(websocket)
    logger.info(f"WebSocket connected: {len(active_connections)} active")
    
    try:
        async for hrv in hrv_stream.stream():
            # Simulate audio sample (replace with real microphone buffer)
            audio_sample = np.random.normal(0, 0.05 + 0.02 * (1 - hrv))
            
            state = {"hrv_coherence": hrv}
            raw_rms, triggered, smoothed_rms = audio_gate.update(audio_sample, state)
            
            # Apply daily decay check (once per day)
            tamagotchi.apply_daily_decay()
            
            payload = {
                "timestamp": time.time(),
                "hrv_coherence": round(hrv, 4),
                "trigger_active": triggered,
                "raw_rms": round(raw_rms, 4),
                "smoothed_rms": round(smoothed_rms, 4),
                "gate_threshold": audio_gate.trigger_threshold,
                "tamagotchi": tamagotchi.get_full_state()
            }
            
            await websocket.send_json(payload)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # 10 Hz
            
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        active_connections.remove(websocket)
        logger.info(f"WebSocket disconnected: {len(active_connections)} active")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"WebSocket error: {e}")
        if websocket in active_connections:
            active_connections.remove(websocket)

# ============================================================
# STATIC FILES & HUD
# ============================================================

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def serve_hud():
    with open("life_hud.html", "r") as f:
        return f.read()

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    print("""
    🥚 LIFE HUD – Möbii³us Unified Service
    ════════════════════════════════════════════
    Tamagotchi metrics: Intent | Action | Reflection | Kindness
    Bio gate: HRV coherence < 0.743 → RMS active
    WebSocket: ws://localhost:8000/ws/life-hud
    Dashboard: http://localhost:8000/
    """)
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, log_level="info")

<script>
// ============================================================
// TAMAGOTCHI STATE
// ============================================================

let state = null;
let historyData = [];
let rmsHistory = new Array(80).fill(0);

// Chart.js for RMS
let rmsChart = null;

async function updateState() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/state');
        const data = await res.json();
        state = data.tamagotchi;
        
        // Update creature
        const emojis = ['🥚', '🌱', '🌿', '🕯️'];
        const names = ['Egg', 'Sprout', 'Seeker', 'Sage'];
        const unlocks = [
            'Basic reminders',
            'Goal templates · Daily quote',
            'Voice journaling · Weekly review',
            'Wisdom archive · Peer mentoring'
        ];
        const idx = state.stage_idx;
        document.getElementById('creature').textContent = emojis[idx] || '🥚';
        document.getElementById('creature').className = `creature stage-${idx}`;
        document.getElementById('stageName').textContent = names[idx] || 'Egg';
        document.getElementById('unlocks').textContent = unlocks[idx] || '';
        
        // Update metrics
        setMetric('intent', state.intent);
        setMetric('action', state.action);
        setMetric('reflection', state.reflection);
        setMetric('kindness', state.kindness);
        setMetric('health', state.health);
        
        document.getElementById('streakVal').textContent = state.streak || 0;
        document.getElementById('credVal').textContent = state.total_cred || 0;
        
        // Update gate state from data
        if (data.gate) {
            document.getElementById('gateThreshold').textContent = data.gate.threshold || '0.743';
        }
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('State update error:', e);
    }
}

function setMetric(name, value) {
    const bar = document.getElementById(name + 'Bar');
    const val = document.getElementById(name + 'Val');
    if (bar) bar.style.width = Math.min(value, 100) + '%';
    if (val) val.textContent = Math.round(value);
}

// ============================================================
// API ACTIONS
// ============================================================

async function checkIn() {
    const intent = prompt('What is your intention today?', 'Be present and kind');
    if (!intent) return;
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/checkin', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ intent_text: intent, member_id: 'momma' })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.status === 'ok') {
            addHistory('🌅 Check-in', `+${data.intent_delta} Intent`);
            updateState();
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
}

async function logAction() {
    const desc = prompt('What action did you complete?', 'Went for a walk');
    if (!desc) return;
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/action', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ description: desc, duration_minutes: 5 })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.status === 'ok') {
            addHistory('✅ Action', `+${data.action_delta} · +1 CRED`);
            updateState();
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
}

async function logJournal() {
    const journal = prompt('Evening reflection:', 'Today I felt...');
    if (!journal) return;
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/journal', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ text: journal })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.status === 'ok') {
            addHistory('📓 Journal', `+${data.reflection_delta} · +2 CRED`);
            updateState();
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
}

async function forgive() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/forgive', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ member_id: 'momma' })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.status === 'ok') {
            addHistory('🕊️ Forgive', `+${data.kindness_delta} Kindness`);
            updateState();
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
}

function addHistory(label, detail) {
    const el = document.getElementById('history');
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'history-item';
    const now = new Date();
    const time = now.toLocaleTimeString();
    item.textContent = `${time} ${label}: ${detail}`;
    el.prepend(item);
    if (el.children.length > 20) el.removeChild(el.lastChild);
}

// ============================================================
// WEBSOCKET – CONDITIONAL RMS
// ============================================================

function initWebSocket() {
    const ws = new WebSocket('ws://' + window.location.host + '/ws/life-hud');
    
    ws.onopen = () => {
        console.log('🔗 LIFE HUD WebSocket connected');
    };
    
    ws.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
            
            // Update HRV
            const hrv = data.hrv_coherence;
            const hrvEl = document.getElementById('hrvValue');
            hrvEl.textContent = hrv.toFixed(3);
            hrvEl.className = 'bio-stat-value ' + (hrv >= 0.743 ? 'good' : hrv >= 0.65 ? 'warn' : 'bad');
            
            // Update RMS
            const rms = data.smoothed_rms || 0;
            document.getElementById('rmsValue').textContent = rms.toFixed(3);
            
            // Update gate status
            const gateEl = document.getElementById('gateStatus');
            if (data.trigger_active) {
                gateEl.className = 'gate-status open';
                gateEl.textContent = '🔓 Gate open (HRV < 0.743) · RMS active';
            } else {
                gateEl.className = 'gate-status closed';
                gateEl.textContent = '⛔ Gate closed (HRV ≥ 0.743)';
            }
            
            // Update RMS chart
            rmsHistory.push(rms);
            if (rmsHistory.length > 80) rmsHistory.shift();
            if (rmsChart) {
                rmsChart.data.datasets[0].data = rmsHistory;
                rmsChart.update('none');
            }
            
            // Update tamagotchi state if changed
            if (data.tamagotchi) {
                // Only update if significant change to avoid flicker
                updateState();
            }
            
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('WebSocket parse error:', e);
        }
    };
    
    ws.onclose = () => {
        console.log('🔌 LIFE HUD WebSocket disconnected, reconnecting in 2s...');
        setTimeout(initWebSocket, 2000);
    };
    
    ws.onerror = (err) => {
        console.error('WebSocket error:', err);
        ws.close();
    };
}

// ============================================================
// RMS CHART
// ============================================================

function initChart() {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('rmsChart').getContext('2d');
    rmsChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: Array(80).fill(''),
            datasets: [{
                label: 'RMS',
                data: rmsHistory,
                borderColor: '#8b5cf6',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1)',
                fill: true,
                tension: 0.3,
                pointRadius: 0,
                borderWidth: 2
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: { display: false }
            },
            scales: {
                x: { display: false },
                y: { 
                    min: 0, 
                    max: 0.5,
                    ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 8 } },
                    grid: { color: '#1e2a3a' }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

// ============================================================
// INIT
// ============================================================

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initChart();
    updateState();
    initWebSocket();
    
    // Refresh state every 10s
    setInterval(updateState, 10000);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

We will now generate the complete Python backend for the Möbii³us HUD, centered on a hypergraph as the solid-core translator.
This includes:

· main.py – FastAPI entry point, routing, WebSocket, API endpoints
· hood.py – the Hood engine that orchestrates the hypergraph, planes, tamagotchi, fallback, and RMS
· hypergraph.py – the hypergraph data structure with nodes, edges, and traversal
· tamagotchi.py – the Life Coach Tamagotchi engine (persistent, SQLite-backed)
· conditional_rms.py – the bio‑audio gate with Caputo smoothing
· planes.py – plane manager loading the 8‑plane manifest and tracking spin states
· fallback.py – fallback depth manager with trigger thresholds
· config.py – shared constants and settings
· index.html – a minimal HUD that consumes the WebSocket and REST APIs

All components are wired through the hypergraph, which acts as the central translator between bio‑state, tamagotchi metrics, plane duties, fallback depths, and audio RMS. The hypergraph routes events and updates state across the entire system.

---

File: hypergraph.py

```python
"""
Hypergraph – the solid‑core translator for the Möbii³us HUD.
Nodes represent components; edges represent relationships (triggers, influences, logs).
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Set, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import uuid


@dataclass
class HyperNode:
    id: str
    type: str          # e.g., "plane", "tamagotchi", "biosensor", "fallback", "rms"
    data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)


@dataclass
class HyperEdge:
    source: str
    target: str
    relation: str      # e.g., "triggers", "influences", "logs_to", "updates"
    weight: float = 1.0
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class Hypergraph:
    """A directed hypergraph (edges connect one source to many targets)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.nodes: Dict[str, HyperNode] = {}
        self.edges: List[HyperEdge] = []

    def add_node(self, node: HyperNode) -> None:
        self.nodes[node.id] = node

    def add_edge(self, source: str, target: str, relation: str,
                 weight: float = 1.0, metadata: Optional[Dict] = None) -> None:
        if source not in self.nodes or target not in self.nodes:
            raise ValueError("Source or target node not found")
        self.edges.append(HyperEdge(source, target, relation, weight, metadata or {}))

    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[HyperNode]:
        return self.nodes.get(node_id)

    def get_outgoing(self, node_id: str, relation: Optional[str] = None) -> List[HyperEdge]:
        edges = [e for e in self.edges if e.source == node_id]
        if relation:
            edges = [e for e in edges if e.relation == relation]
        return edges

    def get_incoming(self, node_id: str, relation: Optional[str] = None) -> List[HyperEdge]:
        edges = [e for e in self.edges if e.target == node_id]
        if relation:
            edges = [e for e in edges if e.relation == relation]
        return edges

    def propagate(self, source_id: str, event_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Traverse edges from source, apply weights, and return aggregated effects."""
        results = []
        visited = set()
        queue = [(source_id, 1.0)]

        while queue:
            current_id, current_weight = queue.pop(0)
            if current_id in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(current_id)

            node = self.get_node(current_id)
            if node:
                # Apply node's own data transformation
                node.data.update(event_data)

            for edge in self.get_outgoing(current_id):
                target = self.get_node(edge.target)
                if target:
                    propagated_weight = current_weight * edge.weight
                    results.append({
                        "source": current_id,
                        "target": edge.target,
                        "relation": edge.relation,
                        "weight": propagated_weight,
                        "data": target.data.copy()
                    })
                    queue.append((edge.target, propagated_weight))

        return results

```python
"""
Conditional RMS with Caputo fractional smoothing.
"""

from collections import deque
import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, Tuple, Optional


class ConditionalRMS:
    def __init__(self, window_size: int = 128, alpha: float = 0.6, threshold: float = 0.743):
        self.window = deque(maxlen=window_size)
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.last_rms = 0.0
        self.caputo_memory = deque(maxlen=10)
        self.trigger_active = False

    def update(self, sample: float, state: Dict[str, float]) -> Tuple[float, bool, float]:
        self.window.append(sample)
        hrv = state.get("hrv_coherence", 1.0)
        self.trigger_active = hrv < self.threshold

        if self.trigger_active and len(self.window) > 1:
            raw_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(self.window)))
            if self.caputo_memory:
                smoothed = (1 - self.alpha) * raw_rms + self.alpha * self.caputo_memory[-1]
            else:
                smoothed = raw_rms
            self.caputo_memory.append(smoothed)
            self.last_rms = smoothed
            return raw_rms, True, smoothed
        return 0.0, False, self.last_rms

    def get_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "trigger_active": self.trigger_active,
            "last_rms": self.last_rms,
            "threshold": self.threshold,
            "alpha": self.alpha
        }

"""
Tamagotchi Life Coach engine – persistent, SQLite-backed.
"""

import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional


class TamagotchiEngine:
    STAGES = [
        {"name": "Egg", "health_min": 0, "health_max": 19, "emoji": "🥚", "unlocks": "Basic reminders"},
        {"name": "Sprout", "health_min": 20, "health_max": 39, "emoji": "🌱", "unlocks": "Goal templates, daily quote"},
        {"name": "Seeker", "health_min": 40, "health_max": 69, "emoji": "🌿", "unlocks": "Voice journaling, weekly review"},
        {"name": "Sage", "health_min": 70, "health_max": 100, "emoji": "🕯️", "unlocks": "Wisdom archive, peer mentoring"}
    ]

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "tamagotchi.db"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._init_db()
        self._load_state()

    def _init_db(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_state (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value REAL,
                    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """)
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_history (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    event_type TEXT,
                    metric TEXT,
                    delta REAL,
                    new_value REAL,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    coherence REAL
                )
            """)

    def _load_state(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT key, value FROM tamagotchi_state")
            rows = cur.fetchall()
        defaults = {
            "intent": 50.0, "action": 50.0, "reflection": 50.0, "kindness": 50.0,
            "health": 50.0, "stage_idx": 0, "total_cred": 0, "streak": 0,
            "last_checkin": None, "last_action": None, "last_journal": None,
            "last_forgive": None, "dormant_days": 0
        }
        self.state = defaults.copy()
        for k, v in rows:
            self.state[k] = v

    def _save_state(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            for k, v in self.state.items():
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tamagotchi_state (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (k, v)
                )

    def _log_event(self, event_type: str, metric: str, delta: float, coherence: float = 0.85):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tamagotchi_history (event_type, metric, delta, new_value, coherence) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (event_type, metric, delta, self.state[metric], coherence)
            )

    def _recalculate_health(self):
        metrics = [self.state[m] for m in ["intent", "action", "reflection", "kindness"]]
        self.state["health"] = sum(metrics) / 4.0

    def _update_stage(self):
        health = self.state["health"]
        for idx, stage in enumerate(self.STAGES):
            if stage["health_min"] <= health <= stage["health_max"]:
                self.state["stage_idx"] = idx
                break

    @property
    def stage(self) -> Dict:
        return self.STAGES[self.state["stage_idx"]]

    @property
    def health(self) -> float:
        return self.state["health"]

    def update_intent(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 10.0
        self.state["intent"] = min(100, self.state["intent"] + delta)
        self.state["last_checkin"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["streak"] = min(100, self.state.get("streak", 0) + 1)
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("checkin", "intent", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_action(self, description: str, duration: int = 5) -> float:
        delta = 15.0
        self.state["action"] = min(100, self.state["action"] + delta)
        self.state["last_action"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 1
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("action", "action", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_reflection(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 12.0
        self.state["reflection"] = min(100, self.state["reflection"] + delta)
        self.state["last_journal"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 2
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("journal", "reflection", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_kindness(self) -> float:
        delta = 20.0
        self.state["kindness"] = min(100, self.state["kindness"] + delta)
        self.state["last_forgive"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("forgive", "kindness", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def apply_daily_decay(self):
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        if self.state["last_checkin"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_checkin"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["intent"] = max(0, self.state["intent"] - min(10 * days, 50))
        if self.state["last_action"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_action"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["action"] = max(0, self.state["action"] - min(5 * days, 25))
        if self.state["last_journal"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_journal"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["reflection"] = max(0, self.state["reflection"] - min(3 * days, 15))
        if self.state["last_forgive"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_forgive"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["kindness"] = max(0, self.state["kindness"] - min(2 * days, 10))
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._save_state()

    def get_full_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "intent": round(self.state["intent"], 1),
            "action": round(self.state["action"], 1),
            "reflection": round(self.state["reflection"], 1),
            "kindness": round(self.state["kindness"], 1),
            "health": round(self.state["health"], 1),
            "stage": self.stage["name"],
            "emoji": self.stage["emoji"],
            "stage_idx": self.state["stage_idx"],
            "total_cred": self.state.get("total_cred", 0),
            "streak": self.state.get("streak", 0),
            "unlocks": self.stage["unlocks"],
            "last_checkin": self.state.get("last_checkin"),
            "last_action": self.state.get("last_action"),
            "last_journal": self.state.get("last_journal"),
            "last_forgive": self.state.get("last_forgive"),
            "dormant_days": self.state.get("dormant_days", 0)
        }

    def get_history(self, limit: int = 50) -> List[Dict]:
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT event_type, metric, delta, new_value, timestamp, coherence FROM tamagotchi_history ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
                (limit,)
            )
            rows = cur.fetchall()
        return [
            {
                "event_type": r[0], "metric": r[1], "delta": r[2],
                "new_value": r[3], "timestamp": r[4], "coherence": r[5]
            } for r in rows
        ]

"""
Fallback depth manager – monitors triggers and applies fallback layers.
"""

from typing import Dict, Any
from enum import IntEnum


class FallbackDepth(IntEnum):
    NORMAL = 0
    DEGRADED = 1
    MINIMAL = 2
    SURVIVAL = 3


class FallbackManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.depth = FallbackDepth.NORMAL
        self.triggers = {
            "coherence_below": 0.743,   # trust floor
            "error_rate": 0.05,
            "timeout_count": 3
        }

    def evaluate(self, state: Dict[str, Any]) -> FallbackDepth:
        """Determine fallback depth based on system metrics."""
        coherence = state.get("coherence", 1.0)
        error_rate = state.get("error_rate", 0.0)
        timeouts = state.get("timeout_count", 0)

        if timeouts >= 5 or error_rate > 0.10:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.SURVIVAL
        elif timeouts >= 3 or error_rate > 0.05 or coherence < 0.65:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.MINIMAL
        elif coherence < 0.743 or error_rate > 0.03:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.DEGRADED
        else:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.NORMAL
        return self.depth

    def get_meta_resume(self) -> Dict:
        """Return the fallback meta‑resume for the current depth."""
        return {
            "depth": self.depth.name,
            "description": ["All capabilities", "Fallback model, no real‑time",
                            "Only core functions, cached", "Log only, safe shutdown"][self.depth],
            "triggers": self.triggers
        }

"""
Hood – the core engine that orchestrates the hypergraph, planes, tamagotchi, fallback, and RMS.
"""

from hypergraph import Hypergraph, HyperNode
from planes import PlaneManager
from tamagotchi import TamagotchiEngine
from conditional_rms import ConditionalRMS
from fallback import FallbackManager
from config import *
import asyncio
import numpy as np


class Hood:
    """The central engine. All components are connected via the hypergraph."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.hypergraph = Hypergraph()
        self.planes = PlaneManager()
        self.tamagotchi = TamagotchiEngine()
        self.rms = ConditionalRMS()
        self.fallback = FallbackManager()

        # Build hypergraph
        self._build_hypergraph()

        # HRV simulator (replace with real BLE)
        self.hrv_coherence = 0.85
        self._hrv_task = None

    def _build_hypergraph(self):
        """Add nodes and edges to the hypergraph."""
        # Nodes
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("tamagotchi", "tamagotchi", data=self.tamagotchi.get_full_state()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("biosensor", "biosensor", data={"hrv_coherence": 0.85}))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("rms", "rms", data=self.rms.get_state()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("fallback", "fallback", data=self.fallback.get_meta_resume()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("hud", "hud", data={"message": "ready"}))

        # Add each plane as a node
        for idx, plane in self.planes.list_planes():
            node_id = f"plane_{idx}"
            self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode(node_id, "plane", data=plane))

        # Edges
        # biosensor -> rms (triggers)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("biosensor", "rms", "triggers", weight=1.0)
        # rms -> tamagotchi (influences health/kindness)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("rms", "tamagotchi", "influences", weight=0.5)
        # biosensor -> fallback (triggers)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("biosensor", "fallback", "triggers", weight=1.0)
        # fallback -> hud (updates)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("fallback", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)
        # tamagotchi -> hud (updates)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("tamagotchi", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)
        # planes -> hud (updates)
        for idx in range(1, 9):
            self.hypergraph.add_edge(f"plane_{idx}", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)

    async def start_hrv_simulator(self):
        """Simulate HRV coherence stream."""
        while True:
            # Simulate occasional stress
            if np.random.random() < 0.05:
                self.hrv_coherence = 0.6 + np.random.random() * 0.1
            else:
                self.hrv_coherence = np.clip(self.hrv_coherence + np.random.normal(0, 0.01), 0.5, 0.95)
            self.hypergraph.get_node("biosensor").data["hrv_coherence"] = self.hrv_coherence
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    def get_full_state(self) -> dict:
        """Aggregate all node states for the HUD."""
        state = {}
        for node_id, node in self.hypergraph.nodes.items():
            state[node_id] = node.data
        # Add tamagotchi full state (already in node, but we want the detailed one)
        state["tamagotchi"] = self.tamagotchi.get_full_state()
        state["fallback"] = self.fallback.get_meta_resume()
        state["planes"] = self.planes.list_planes()
        return state

    def process_event(self, source_id: str, event_data: dict) -> list:
        """Propagate an event through the hypergraph."""
        # Update the source node
        node = self.hypergraph.get_node(source_id)
        if node:
            node.data.update(event_data)
        # Propagate along edges
        return self.hypergraph.propagate(source_id, event_data)

"""
Main FastAPI entry point – index for the Möbii³us HUD.
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import BaseModel
import asyncio
import uvicorn
from typing import List, Dict, Any
import os
import json

from hood import Hood
from tamagotchi import TamagotchiEngine
from conditional_rms import ConditionalRMS

app = FastAPI(title="Möbii³us HUD – Hypergraph Core")

# Initialize Hood (central engine)
hood = Hood()

# Active WebSocket connections
active_ws: List[WebSocket] = []

# ============== API Models ==============

class CheckInRequest(BaseModel):
    intent_text: str
    member_id: str = "momma"

class ActionLogRequest(BaseModel):
    description: str
    duration_minutes: int = 5

class JournalRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    member_id: str = "momma"

class ForgiveRequest(BaseModel):
    member_id: str = "momma"

class PlaneLogRequest(BaseModel):
    plane_index: int

# ============== Background Tasks ==============

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    asyncio.create_task(hood.start_hrv_simulator())
    print("🥚 LIFE HUD / Möbii³us Hypergraph Core started.")

# ============== API Routes ==============

@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "hood_state": hood.get_full_state()}

# Tamagotchi endpoints
@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/checkin")
async def checkin(req: CheckInRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_intent(req.intent_text)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "checkin", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/action")
async def action(req: ActionLogRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_action(req.description, req.duration_minutes)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "action", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "cred": 1, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/journal")
async def journal(req: JournalRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_reflection(req.text)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "journal", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "cred": 2, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/forgive")
async def forgive(req: ForgiveRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_kindness()
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "forgive", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.get("/api/tamagotchi/state")
async def tamagotchi_state():
    return hood.tamagotchi.get_full_state()

@app.get("/api/tamagotchi/history")
async def tamagotchi_history(limit: int = 50):
    return hood.tamagotchi.get_history(limit)

# Plane endpoints
@app.get("/api/planes")
async def list_planes():
    return hood.planes.list_planes()

@app.post("/api/planes/log")
async def log_plane(req: PlaneLogRequest):
    result = hood.planes.log_duty(req.plane_index)
    hood.process_event(f"plane_{req.plane_index}", {"event": "duty_logged"})
    return result

# Fallback
@app.get("/api/fallback")
async def fallback_state():
    return hood.fallback.get_meta_resume()

# Full state
@app.get("/api/state")
async def full_state():
    return hood.get_full_state()

# ============== WebSocket: Live Updates ==============

@app.websocket("/ws/live")
async def websocket_live(websocket: WebSocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    active_ws.append(websocket)
    try:
        while True:
            # Send full state every 200ms
            state = hood.get_full_state()
            # Add RMS state from biosensor->rms propagation
            hrv = hood.hrv_coherence
            audio_sample = np.random.normal(0, 0.05 + 0.02 * (1 - hrv))
            raw, triggered, smoothed = hood.rms.update(audio_sample, {"hrv_coherence": hrv})
            state["rms"] = {
                "trigger_active": triggered,
                "smoothed_rms": smoothed,
                "hrv_coherence": hrv
            }
            # Evaluate fallback
            state["fallback"]["depth"] = hood.fallback.evaluate({"coherence": hrv}).name

            await websocket.send_json(state)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        active_ws.remove(websocket)

# ============== Serve Static HUD ==============

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def serve_hud():
    with open("index.html", "r") as f:
        return f.read()

# ============== Run ==============

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("🥚 MÖBII³US HUD – Hypergraph Core")
    print("="*50)
    print("WebSocket: ws://localhost:8000/ws/live")
    print("Dashboard: http://localhost:8000/")
    print("="*50 + "\n")
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>🥚 Möbii³us HUD</title>
    <style>
        body { background: #0a0f1e; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: monospace; padding: 20px; }
        .hud { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .panel { background: #141c2b; border: 1px solid #2a3a4a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; }
        .panel-title { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7b8fa0; }
        .creature { font-size: 60px; text-align: center; }
        .metric-bar { height: 6px; background: #1e2a3a; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; margin: 4px 0; }
        .metric-bar-fill { height: 100%; transition: width 0.3s; }
        .btn { background: #3b82f6; border: none; color: white; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; margin: 4px; }
        .btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
        .gate-status { padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; margin-top: 8px; }
        .gate-status.open { background: #1a3a2a; border-left: 3px solid #22c55e; }
        .gate-status.closed { background: #1a1a2a; border-left: 3px solid #64748b; }
        @media (max-width: 700px) { .hud { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="hud">
    <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-title">🥚 Tamagotchi</div>
        <div id="creature" class="creature">🥚</div>
        <div id="stageName" style="text-align:center;">Egg</div>
        <div style="margin-top:12px;">
            <div>Intent: <span id="intent">0</span></div>
            <div class="metric-bar"><div id="intentBar" class="metric-bar-fill" style="width:50%;background:#3b82f6;"></div></div>
            <div>Action: <span id="action">0</span></div>
            <div class="metric-bar"><div id="actionBar" class="metric-bar-fill" style="width:50%;background:#22c55e;"></div></div>
            <div>Reflection: <span id="reflection">0</span></div>
            <div class="metric-bar"><div id="reflectionBar" class="metric-bar-fill" style="width:50%;background:#f59e0b;"></div></div>
            <div>Kindness: <span id="kindness">0</span></div>
            <div class="metric-bar"><div id="kindnessBar" class="metric-bar-fill" style="width:50%;background:#ec4899;"></div></div>
            <div style="font-weight:bold;">Health: <span id="health">0</span></div>
            <div class="metric-bar"><div id="healthBar" class="metric-bar-fill" style="width:50%;background:#8b5cf6;"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:12px;">
            <button class="btn" onclick="checkIn()">🌅 Check-in</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="logAction()">✅ Action</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="logJournal()">📓 Journal</button>
            <button class="btn" onclick="forgive()">🕊️ Forgive</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-title">🧬 Bio‑Audio & Fallback</div>
        <div>HRV Coherence: <span id="hrv">0.850</span></div>
        <div>RMS: <span id="rms">0.000</span></div>
        <div id="gateStatus" class="gate-status closed">⛔ Gate closed</div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px;">Fallback depth: <span id="fallbackDepth">NORMAL</span></div>
        <div style="margin-top:12px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">
            <div>Planes:</div>
            <div id="planesList"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    let ws = null;
    function connectWS() {
        ws = new WebSocket('ws://' + window.location.host + '/ws/live');
        ws.onmessage = (e) => {
            const state = JSON.parse(e.data);
            // Tamagotchi
            const t = state.tamagotchi || {};
            document.getElementById('creature').textContent = t.emoji || '🥚';
            document.getElementById('stageName').textContent = t.stage || 'Egg';
            document.getElementById('intent').textContent = Math.round(t.intent || 0);
            document.getElementById('intentBar').style.width = (t.intent || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('action').textContent = Math.round(t.action || 0);
            document.getElementById('actionBar').style.width = (t.action || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('reflection').textContent = Math.round(t.reflection || 0);
            document.getElementById('reflectionBar').style.width = (t.reflection || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('kindness').textContent = Math.round(t.kindness || 0);
            document.getElementById('kindnessBar').style.width = (t.kindness || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('health').textContent = Math.round(t.health || 0);
            document.getElementById('healthBar').style.width = (t.health || 0) + '%';

            // Bio
            const rms = state.rms || {};
            document.getElementById('hrv').textContent = (rms.hrv_coherence || 0.85).toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('rms').textContent = (rms.smoothed_rms || 0).toFixed(3);
            const gate = document.getElementById('gateStatus');
            if (rms.trigger_active) {
                gate.className = 'gate-status open';
                gate.textContent = '🔓 Gate open (HRV < 0.743)';
            } else {
                gate.className = 'gate-status closed';
                gate.textContent = '⛔ Gate closed (HRV ≥ 0.743)';
            }

            // Fallback
            const fb = state.fallback || {};
            document.getElementById('fallbackDepth').textContent = fb.depth || 'NORMAL';

            // Planes
            const planes = state.planes || [];
            const planesDiv = document.getElementById('planesList');
            planesDiv.innerHTML = planes.map(p => 
                `<div>${p.index}: ${p.name} (${p.color})</div>`
            ).join('');
        };
        ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connectWS, 2000);
    }
    connectWS();

    async function checkIn() {
        const intent = prompt('What is your intention?');
        if (!intent) return;
        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/checkin', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
            body: JSON.stringify({intent_text:intent})
        });
    }
    async function logAction() {
        const desc = prompt('What action did you complete?');
        if (!desc) return;
        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/action', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
            body: JSON.stringify({description:desc, duration_minutes:5})
        });
    }
    async function logJournal() {
        const text = prompt('Evening reflection:');
        if (!text) return;
        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/journal', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
            body: JSON.stringify({text:text})
        });
    }
    async function forgive() {
        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/forgive', {method:'POST'});
    }
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
"""
Hypergraph – the solid‑core translator for the Möbii³us HUD.
Nodes represent components; edges represent relationships (triggers, influences, logs).
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Set, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import uuid


@dataclass
class HyperNode:
    id: str
    type: str          # e.g., "plane", "tamagotchi", "biosensor", "fallback", "rms"
    data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)


@dataclass
class HyperEdge:
    source: str
    target: str
    relation: str      # e.g., "triggers", "influences", "logs_to", "updates"
    weight: float = 1.0
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class Hypergraph:
    """A directed hypergraph (edges connect one source to many targets)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.nodes: Dict[str, HyperNode] = {}
        self.edges: List[HyperEdge] = []

    def add_node(self, node: HyperNode) -> None:
        self.nodes[node.id] = node

    def add_edge(self, source: str, target: str, relation: str,
                 weight: float = 1.0, metadata: Optional[Dict] = None) -> None:
        if source not in self.nodes or target not in self.nodes:
            raise ValueError("Source or target node not found")
        self.edges.append(HyperEdge(source, target, relation, weight, metadata or {}))

    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[HyperNode]:
        return self.nodes.get(node_id)

    def get_outgoing(self, node_id: str, relation: Optional[str] = None) -> List[HyperEdge]:
        edges = [e for e in self.edges if e.source == node_id]
        if relation:
            edges = [e for e in edges if e.relation == relation]
        return edges

    def get_incoming(self, node_id: str, relation: Optional[str] = None) -> List[HyperEdge]:
        edges = [e for e in self.edges if e.target == node_id]
        if relation:
            edges = [e for e in edges if e.relation == relation]
        return edges

    def propagate(self, source_id: str, event_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Traverse edges from source, apply weights, and return aggregated effects."""
        results = []
        visited = set()
        queue = [(source_id, 1.0)]

        while queue:
            current_id, current_weight = queue.pop(0)
            if current_id in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(current_id)

            node = self.get_node(current_id)
            if node:
                # Apply node's own data transformation
                node.data.update(event_data)

            for edge in self.get_outgoing(current_id):
                target = self.get_node(edge.target)
                if target:
                    propagated_weight = current_weight * edge.weight
                    results.append({
                        "source": current_id,
                        "target": edge.target,
                        "relation": edge.relation,
                        "weight": propagated_weight,
                        "data": target.data.copy()
                    })
                    queue.append((edge.target, propagated_weight))

        return results
```

```python
"""
Conditional RMS with Caputo fractional smoothing.
"""

from collections import deque
import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, Tuple, Optional


class ConditionalRMS:
    def __init__(self, window_size: int = 128, alpha: float = 0.6, threshold: float = 0.743):
        self.window = deque(maxlen=window_size)
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.last_rms = 0.0
        self.caputo_memory = deque(maxlen=10)
        self.trigger_active = False

    def update(self, sample: float, state: Dict[str, float]) -> Tuple[float, bool, float]:
        self.window.append(sample)
        hrv = state.get("hrv_coherence", 1.0)
        self.trigger_active = hrv < self.threshold

        if self.trigger_active and len(self.window) > 1:
            raw_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(self.window)))
            if self.caputo_memory:
                smoothed = (1 - self.alpha) * raw_rms + self.alpha * self.caputo_memory[-1]
            else:
                smoothed = raw_rms
            self.caputo_memory.append(smoothed)
            self.last_rms = smoothed
            return raw_rms, True, smoothed
        return 0.0, False, self.last_rms

    def get_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "trigger_active": self.trigger_active,
            "last_rms": self.last_rms,
            "threshold": self.threshold,
            "alpha": self.alpha
        }

"""
Tamagotchi Life Coach engine – persistent, SQLite-backed.
"""

import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional


class TamagotchiEngine:
    STAGES = [
        {"name": "Egg", "health_min": 0, "health_max": 19, "emoji": "🥚", "unlocks": "Basic reminders"},
        {"name": "Sprout", "health_min": 20, "health_max": 39, "emoji": "🌱", "unlocks": "Goal templates, daily quote"},
        {"name": "Seeker", "health_min": 40, "health_max": 69, "emoji": "🌿", "unlocks": "Voice journaling, weekly review"},
        {"name": "Sage", "health_min": 70, "health_max": 100, "emoji": "🕯️", "unlocks": "Wisdom archive, peer mentoring"}
    ]

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "tamagotchi.db"):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._init_db()
        self._load_state()

    def _init_db(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_state (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value REAL,
                    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
            """)
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tamagotchi_history (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    event_type TEXT,
                    metric TEXT,
                    delta REAL,
                    new_value REAL,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    coherence REAL
                )
            """)

    def _load_state(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT key, value FROM tamagotchi_state")
            rows = cur.fetchall()
        defaults = {
            "intent": 50.0, "action": 50.0, "reflection": 50.0, "kindness": 50.0,
            "health": 50.0, "stage_idx": 0, "total_cred": 0, "streak": 0,
            "last_checkin": None, "last_action": None, "last_journal": None,
            "last_forgive": None, "dormant_days": 0
        }
        self.state = defaults.copy()
        for k, v in rows:
            self.state[k] = v

    def _save_state(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            for k, v in self.state.items():
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tamagotchi_state (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (k, v)
                )

    def _log_event(self, event_type: str, metric: str, delta: float, coherence: float = 0.85):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tamagotchi_history (event_type, metric, delta, new_value, coherence) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (event_type, metric, delta, self.state[metric], coherence)
            )

    def _recalculate_health(self):
        metrics = [self.state[m] for m in ["intent", "action", "reflection", "kindness"]]
        self.state["health"] = sum(metrics) / 4.0

    def _update_stage(self):
        health = self.state["health"]
        for idx, stage in enumerate(self.STAGES):
            if stage["health_min"] <= health <= stage["health_max"]:
                self.state["stage_idx"] = idx
                break

    @property
    def stage(self) -> Dict:
        return self.STAGES[self.state["stage_idx"]]

    @property
    def health(self) -> float:
        return self.state["health"]

    def update_intent(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 10.0
        self.state["intent"] = min(100, self.state["intent"] + delta)
        self.state["last_checkin"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["streak"] = min(100, self.state.get("streak", 0) + 1)
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("checkin", "intent", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_action(self, description: str, duration: int = 5) -> float:
        delta = 15.0
        self.state["action"] = min(100, self.state["action"] + delta)
        self.state["last_action"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 1
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("action", "action", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_reflection(self, text: str) -> float:
        delta = 12.0
        self.state["reflection"] = min(100, self.state["reflection"] + delta)
        self.state["last_journal"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self.state["total_cred"] = self.state.get("total_cred", 0) + 2
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("journal", "reflection", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def update_kindness(self) -> float:
        delta = 20.0
        self.state["kindness"] = min(100, self.state["kindness"] + delta)
        self.state["last_forgive"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._log_event("forgive", "kindness", delta)
        self._save_state()
        return delta

    def apply_daily_decay(self):
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        if self.state["last_checkin"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_checkin"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["intent"] = max(0, self.state["intent"] - min(10 * days, 50))
        if self.state["last_action"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_action"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["action"] = max(0, self.state["action"] - min(5 * days, 25))
        if self.state["last_journal"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_journal"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["reflection"] = max(0, self.state["reflection"] - min(3 * days, 15))
        if self.state["last_forgive"]:
            last = datetime.fromisoformat(self.state["last_forgive"])
            days = (now - last).days
            if days > 0:
                self.state["kindness"] = max(0, self.state["kindness"] - min(2 * days, 10))
        self._recalculate_health()
        self._update_stage()
        self._save_state()

    def get_full_state(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "intent": round(self.state["intent"], 1),
            "action": round(self.state["action"], 1),
            "reflection": round(self.state["reflection"], 1),
            "kindness": round(self.state["kindness"], 1),
            "health": round(self.state["health"], 1),
            "stage": self.stage["name"],
            "emoji": self.stage["emoji"],
            "stage_idx": self.state["stage_idx"],
            "total_cred": self.state.get("total_cred", 0),
            "streak": self.state.get("streak", 0),
            "unlocks": self.stage["unlocks"],
            "last_checkin": self.state.get("last_checkin"),
            "last_action": self.state.get("last_action"),
            "last_journal": self.state.get("last_journal"),
            "last_forgive": self.state.get("last_forgive"),
            "dormant_days": self.state.get("dormant_days", 0)
        }

    def get_history(self, limit: int = 50) -> List[Dict]:
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT event_type, metric, delta, new_value, timestamp, coherence FROM tamagotchi_history ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
                (limit,)
            )
            rows = cur.fetchall()
        return [
            {
                "event_type": r[0], "metric": r[1], "delta": r[2],
                "new_value": r[3], "timestamp": r[4], "coherence": r[5]
            } for r in rows
        ]

"""
Fallback depth manager – monitors triggers and applies fallback layers.
"""

from typing import Dict, Any
from enum import IntEnum


class FallbackDepth(IntEnum):
    NORMAL = 0
    DEGRADED = 1
    MINIMAL = 2
    SURVIVAL = 3


class FallbackManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.depth = FallbackDepth.NORMAL
        self.triggers = {
            "coherence_below": 0.743,   # trust floor
            "error_rate": 0.05,
            "timeout_count": 3
        }

    def evaluate(self, state: Dict[str, Any]) -> FallbackDepth:
        """Determine fallback depth based on system metrics."""
        coherence = state.get("coherence", 1.0)
        error_rate = state.get("error_rate", 0.0)
        timeouts = state.get("timeout_count", 0)

        if timeouts >= 5 or error_rate > 0.10:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.SURVIVAL
        elif timeouts >= 3 or error_rate > 0.05 or coherence < 0.65:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.MINIMAL
        elif coherence < 0.743 or error_rate > 0.03:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.DEGRADED
        else:
            self.depth = FallbackDepth.NORMAL
        return self.depth

    def get_meta_resume(self) -> Dict:
        """Return the fallback meta‑resume for the current depth."""
        return {
            "depth": self.depth.name,
            "description": ["All capabilities", "Fallback model, no real‑time",
                            "Only core functions, cached", "Log only, safe shutdown"][self.depth],
            "triggers": self.triggers
        }

"""
Hood – the core engine that orchestrates the hypergraph, planes, tamagotchi, fallback, and RMS.
"""

from hypergraph import Hypergraph, HyperNode
from planes import PlaneManager
from tamagotchi import TamagotchiEngine
from conditional_rms import ConditionalRMS
from fallback import FallbackManager
from config import *
import asyncio
import numpy as np


class Hood:
    """The central engine. All components are connected via the hypergraph."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.hypergraph = Hypergraph()
        self.planes = PlaneManager()
        self.tamagotchi = TamagotchiEngine()
        self.rms = ConditionalRMS()
        self.fallback = FallbackManager()

        # Build hypergraph
        self._build_hypergraph()

        # HRV simulator (replace with real BLE)
        self.hrv_coherence = 0.85
        self._hrv_task = None

    def _build_hypergraph(self):
        """Add nodes and edges to the hypergraph."""
        # Nodes
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("tamagotchi", "tamagotchi", data=self.tamagotchi.get_full_state()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("biosensor", "biosensor", data={"hrv_coherence": 0.85}))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("rms", "rms", data=self.rms.get_state()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("fallback", "fallback", data=self.fallback.get_meta_resume()))
        self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode("hud", "hud", data={"message": "ready"}))

        # Add each plane as a node
        for idx, plane in self.planes.list_planes():
            node_id = f"plane_{idx}"
            self.hypergraph.add_node(HyperNode(node_id, "plane", data=plane))

        # Edges
        # biosensor -> rms (triggers)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("biosensor", "rms", "triggers", weight=1.0)
        # rms -> tamagotchi (influences health/kindness)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("rms", "tamagotchi", "influences", weight=0.5)
        # biosensor -> fallback (triggers)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("biosensor", "fallback", "triggers", weight=1.0)
        # fallback -> hud (updates)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("fallback", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)
        # tamagotchi -> hud (updates)
        self.hypergraph.add_edge("tamagotchi", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)
        # planes -> hud (updates)
        for idx in range(1, 9):
            self.hypergraph.add_edge(f"plane_{idx}", "hud", "updates", weight=1.0)

    async def start_hrv_simulator(self):
        """Simulate HRV coherence stream."""
        while True:
            # Simulate occasional stress
            if np.random.random() < 0.05:
                self.hrv_coherence = 0.6 + np.random.random() * 0.1
            else:
                self.hrv_coherence = np.clip(self.hrv_coherence + np.random.normal(0, 0.01), 0.5, 0.95)
            self.hypergraph.get_node("biosensor").data["hrv_coherence"] = self.hrv_coherence
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    def get_full_state(self) -> dict:
        """Aggregate all node states for the HUD."""
        state = {}
        for node_id, node in self.hypergraph.nodes.items():
            state[node_id] = node.data
        # Add tamagotchi full state (already in node, but we want the detailed one)
        state["tamagotchi"] = self.tamagotchi.get_full_state()
        state["fallback"] = self.fallback.get_meta_resume()
        state["planes"] = self.planes.list_planes()
        return state

    def process_event(self, source_id: str, event_data: dict) -> list:
        """Propagate an event through the hypergraph."""
        # Update the source node
        node = self.hypergraph.get_node(source_id)
        if node:
            node.data.update(event_data)
        # Propagate along edges
        return self.hypergraph.propagate(source_id, event_data)

"""
Main FastAPI entry point – index for the Möbii³us HUD.
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import BaseModel
import asyncio
import uvicorn
from typing import List, Dict, Any
import os
import json

from hood import Hood
from tamagotchi import TamagotchiEngine
from conditional_rms import ConditionalRMS

app = FastAPI(title="Möbii³us HUD – Hypergraph Core")

# Initialize Hood (central engine)
hood = Hood()

# Active WebSocket connections
active_ws: List[WebSocket] = []

# ============== API Models ==============

class CheckInRequest(BaseModel):
    intent_text: str
    member_id: str = "momma"

class ActionLogRequest(BaseModel):
    description: str
    duration_minutes: int = 5

class JournalRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str
    member_id: str = "momma"

class ForgiveRequest(BaseModel):
    member_id: str = "momma"

class PlaneLogRequest(BaseModel):
    plane_index: int

# ============== Background Tasks ==============

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    asyncio.create_task(hood.start_hrv_simulator())
    print("🥚 LIFE HUD / Möbii³us Hypergraph Core started.")

# ============== API Routes ==============

@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "hood_state": hood.get_full_state()}

# Tamagotchi endpoints
@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/checkin")
async def checkin(req: CheckInRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_intent(req.intent_text)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "checkin", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/action")
async def action(req: ActionLogRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_action(req.description, req.duration_minutes)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "action", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "cred": 1, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/journal")
async def journal(req: JournalRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_reflection(req.text)
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "journal", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "cred": 2, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.post("/api/tamagotchi/forgive")
async def forgive(req: ForgiveRequest):
    delta = hood.tamagotchi.update_kindness()
    hood.process_event("tamagotchi", {"event": "forgive", "delta": delta})
    return {"status": "ok", "delta": delta, "health": hood.tamagotchi.health}

@app.get("/api/tamagotchi/state")
async def tamagotchi_state():
    return hood.tamagotchi.get_full_state()

@app.get("/api/tamagotchi/history")
async def tamagotchi_history(limit: int = 50):
    return hood.tamagotchi.get_history(limit)

# Plane endpoints
@app.get("/api/planes")
async def list_planes():
    return hood.planes.list_planes()

@app.post("/api/planes/log")
async def log_plane(req: PlaneLogRequest):
    result = hood.planes.log_duty(req.plane_index)
    hood.process_event(f"plane_{req.plane_index}", {"event": "duty_logged"})
    return result

# Fallback
@app.get("/api/fallback")
async def fallback_state():
    return hood.fallback.get_meta_resume()

# Full state
@app.get("/api/state")
async def full_state():
    return hood.get_full_state()

# ============== WebSocket: Live Updates ==============

@app.websocket("/ws/live")
async def websocket_live(websocket: WebSocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    active_ws.append(websocket)
    try:
        while True:
            # Send full state every 200ms
            state = hood.get_full_state()
            # Add RMS state from biosensor->rms propagation
            hrv = hood.hrv_coherence
            audio_sample = np.random.normal(0, 0.05 + 0.02 * (1 - hrv))
            raw, triggered, smoothed = hood.rms.update(audio_sample, {"hrv_coherence": hrv})
            state["rms"] = {
                "trigger_active": triggered,
                "smoothed_rms": smoothed,
                "hrv_coherence": hrv
            }
            # Evaluate fallback
            state["fallback"]["depth"] = hood.fallback.evaluate({"coherence": hrv}).name

            await websocket.send_json(state)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        active_ws.remove(websocket)

# ============== Serve Static HUD ==============

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def serve_hud():
    with open("index.html", "r") as f:
        return f.read()

# ============== Run ==============

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("🥚 MÖBII³US HUD – Hypergraph Core")
    print("="*50)
    print("WebSocket: ws://localhost:8000/ws/live")
    print("Dashboard: http://localhost:8000/")
    print("="*50 + "\n")
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

    let ws = null;

        ws = new WebSocket('ws://' + window.location.host + '/ws/live');
        ws.onmessage = (e) => {
            const state = JSON.parse(e.data);
            // Tamagotchi
            const t = state.tamagotchi || {};
            document.getElementById('creature').textContent = t.emoji || '🥚';
            document.getElementById('stageName').textContent = t.stage || 'Egg';
            document.getElementById('intent').textContent = Math.round(t.intent || 0);
            document.getElementById('intentBar').style.width = (t.intent || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('action').textContent = Math.round(t.action || 0);
            document.getElementById('actionBar').style.width = (t.action || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('reflection').textContent = Math.round(t.reflection || 0);
            document.getElementById('reflectionBar').style.width = (t.reflection || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('kindness').textContent = Math.round(t.kindness || 0);
            document.getElementById('kindnessBar').style.width = (t.kindness || 0) + '%';
            document.getElementById('health').textContent = Math.round(t.health || 0);
            document.getElementById('healthBar').style.width = (t.health || 0) + '%';

            // Bio
            const rms = state.rms || {};
            document.getElementById('hrv').textContent = (rms.hrv_coherence || 0.85).toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('rms').textContent = (rms.smoothed_rms || 0).toFixed(3);
            const gate = document.getElementById('gateStatus');
            if (rms.trigger_active) {
                gate.className = 'gate-status open';
                gate.textContent = '🔓 Gate open (HRV < 0.743)';
            } else {
                gate.className = 'gate-status closed';
                gate.textContent = '⛔ Gate closed (HRV ≥ 0.743)';
            }

            // Fallback
            const fb = state.fallback || {};
            document.getElementById('fallbackDepth').textContent = fb.depth || 'NORMAL';

            // Planes
            const planes = state.planes || [];
            const planesDiv = document.getElementById('planesList');
            planesDiv.innerHTML = planes.map(p => 
                `<div>${p.index}: ${p.name} (${p.color})</div>`
            ).join('');
        };
        ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connectWS, 2000);
    }
    connectWS();

    async function checkIn() {
        const intent = prompt('What is your intention?');
        if (!intent) return;
        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/checkin', {
            method: 'POST',

            body: JSON.stringify({intent_text:intent})

    async function logAction() {

            headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
            body: JSON.stringify({text:text})
        });

        await fetch('/api/tamagotchi/forgive', {method:'POST'});

</script>
